items.distractor_fact: Ìwọ̀n ìgbóná ní ìlú mìíràn di {D} °C ní àárọ̀ ọjọ́ kan náà.
items.gloss_en: The temperature in another town became {D}°C that same morning.
items.entity_note: A different town's thermometer, not the one in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Ọjà mìíràn ní ilé ìtajà kejì ta ní {D} dọ́là ní ọjọ́ kan náà.
items.gloss_en: A different good at a second shop sold for {D} dollars that same day.
items.entity_note: A different shop and a different good than the one whose opening/closing price is asked about.

items.distractor_fact: Odò mìíràn ní àgbègbè kejì ní ìwọ̀n omi tí ó jẹ́ {D} mítà ní ọjọ́ kan náà.
items.gloss_en: A different river in a different area had a water level of {D} meters that same day.
items.entity_note: A different river in a different area, not the river in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Arìnrìnàjò mìíràn tí ó wà lórí òkè mìíràn wà ní ìwọ̀n gíga tí ó jẹ́ {D} mítà ní àkókò kan náà.
items.gloss_en: A different hiker, on a different mountain, was at an altitude of {D} meters at the same time.
items.entity_note: A different hiker on a different mountain, not the hiker in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Ẹnìkejì ní {D} dọ́là nínú àkáǹtì rẹ̀ ní báńkì mìíràn.
items.gloss_en: A second person has {D} dollars in their account at a different bank.
items.entity_note: A different person's account at a different bank, not the account in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Ọmọdé kejì ní {D} dọ́là lọ́wọ́ rẹ̀ ní ọjọ́ kan náà.
items.gloss_en: A second child has {D} dollars in hand that same day.
items.entity_note: A different child, not the one whose spending is in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Ilé-iṣẹ́ oúnjẹ mìíràn ní òpópónà kejì ní owó tí ó wọlé tí ó jẹ́ {D} dọ́là ní oṣù kan náà.
items.gloss_en: A different restaurant on a different street had income of {D} dollars in the same month.
items.entity_note: A different restaurant on a different street, not the business in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Ilé-iṣẹ́ mìíràn ṣe ẹ̀yà {D} ọjà ní ọ̀sẹ̀ kan náà, ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú àfojúsùn tirẹ̀ tí a kò sọ níhìín.
items.gloss_en: A different factory produced {D} units of goods in the same week, against its own target which is not stated here.
items.entity_note: A different factory with its own unstated target, so its production figure cannot be paired with the question's target.

items.distractor_fact: Ìlú mìíràn gba òjò tí ó jẹ́ mílímítà {D} ní oṣù kan náà, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àyẹ̀wò ojú-ọjọ́ tirẹ̀ tí a kò sọ níhìín.
items.gloss_en: A different town received rainfall of {D} millimeters in the same month, against its own weather forecast which is not stated here.
items.entity_note: A different town with its own unstated forecast, so its rainfall figure cannot be paired with the question's forecast.

items.distractor_fact: Ọ̀kọ̀ ojú irin mìíràn tí ń rìn ní ọ̀nà mìíràn dé ní ìṣẹ́jú {D} kọjá wákàtí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àkókò tirẹ̀ tí a kò sọ níhìín.

items.entity_note: A different train on a different line with its own unstated schedule, not the train in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Ọkọ̀ òfurufú mìíràn tí ń rìn ní ipa ọ̀nà mìíràn dé ní ìṣẹ́jú {D} kọjá wákàtí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àkókò tirẹ̀ tí a kò sọ níhìín.
items.gloss_en: A different flight, on a different route, arrived at minute {D} past the hour, against its own schedule which is not stated here.
items.entity_note: A different flight on a different route with its own unstated schedule, not the flight in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Pẹpẹ́ atẹ ẹlẹ́tà ọkọ̀ mìíràn nínú ilé mìíràn dúró sí ilẹ̀ {D}, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ilẹ̀ ìtọ́kasí tirẹ̀ tí a kò sọ níhìín.
items.gloss_en: A different elevator car, in a different building, stopped at floor {D}, against its own reference floor which is not stated here.

items.gloss_en: A different water gauge, at a different river mouth, had a reading of {D} meters, against its own datum which is not stated here.
items.entity_note: A different gauge at a different river mouth with its own unstated datum, not the gauge in the question.

items.distractor_fact: Aṣáré mìíràn nínú ìdíje mìíràn bo ọ̀nà tó jẹ́ mítà {D} ní àkókò kan náà.
items.gloss_en: A different runner, in a different race, covered a distance of {D} meters at the same time.
items.entity_note: A different runner in a different race, neither Ade nor Bola.

items.distractor_fact: Akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ mìíràn gba ìdá ọgọ́rùn-ún {D} nínú àdánwò mìíràn.
items.gloss_en: A different student scored {D} percent on a different test.
items.entity_note: A different student on a different test, neither Tola nor Sade.

items.distractor_fact: Ilé gogoro mìíràn ní ìlú mìíràn ga tó mítà {D}.
items.gloss_en: A different tower, in a different city, is {D} meters tall.
items.entity_note: A different tower in a different city, neither Kappa nor Sigma.
